critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/src/App.js is ~3197 lines — continue to grow; splitting WarehousePage and InstructionsPage into separate modules is overdue.

The /api/files endpoint is intentionally public per spec, but there is no path sanitisation visible on the endpoint call site — consider validating that the requested storage_path is within an allowed prefix (e.g. APP_NAME/) to prevent arbitrary path traversal on the object store bucket.
InstructionsPage.uploadFile does not restrict client-side file size/type; large uploads will be attempted synchronously with no progress UI. Consider a maxSize guard and content-type allowlist.
delete_instruction_file removes the metadata entry but does NOT delete the object from object storage — orphan blobs will accumulate. Consider best-effort delete_object() on remove.
